AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Trusted administrator record for RBAC verification.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin was registered.

SiteCmsConfig.title: SiteCmsConfig
SiteCmsConfig.description: Site-wide CMS metadata and Cloudflare R2 CDN links. Binary or base64 image data is strictly forbidden in Firestore; all images are stored in Cloudflare R2 and referenced by CDN URL.

updatedBy.description: UID or system identifier that updated the CMS document.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last CMS update.

tours.description: List of private tour packages (up to 50 items) referencing Cloudflare R2 CDN image URLs.

stays.description: List of boutique stays (up to 50 items) referencing Cloudflare R2 CDN image URLs.

destinations.description: List of regional destinations (up to 50 items) referencing Cloudflare R2 CDN image URLs.

gallery.description: List of gallery photo metadata (up to 100 items) referencing Cloudflare R2 CDN image URLs.

reviews.description: List of guest reviews (up to 100 items).

faqs.description: List of planning FAQs (up to 100 items).

R2MediaItem.title: R2MediaItem
R2MediaItem.description: Metadata index of an image object stored in the Cloudflare R2 bucket, linking the R2 object key and R2 public CDN URL to Firebase.

id.description: Document ID matching sanitized R2 object identifier.

objectKey.description: Object key inside the Cloudflare R2 bucket (e.g. tours/173000-sigiriya.jpg).

cdnUrl.description: Public Cloudflare R2 CDN URL (https://...) — never data:image base64.

folder.description: Logical R2 folder category (tours, stays, destinations, gallery, general).

fileName.description: Original file name uploaded from device storage.

contentType.description: MIME type of the image object in R2.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the object in Cloudflare R2 in bytes.

uploadedBy.description: Admin UID who uploaded or updated the R2 object.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial R2 upload.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest R2 update.

CustomerEnquiry.title: CustomerEnquiry
CustomerEnquiry.description: Private customer trip enquiry containing traveller PII, isolated to admin access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when enquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when enquiry was last updated.

/site_cms/{docId}.description: Publicly readable site CMS configuration storing Cloudflare R2 CDN links (never binary/base64 images); writable only by verified admins.

/r2_media/{mediaId}.description: Catalog of Cloudflare R2 bucket objects and their public CDN URLs accessed through Firebase.

/enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Customer trip enquiries containing PII, readable and manageable strictly by verified admins.
